name: boundary-rebalance-no-trade-band
note: Rejected solely on the trade-count criterion (2 vs 70 = 3% of baseline). Sharpe improved 4.782 absolute and max drawdown improved 2.18pp, and every metric improved at 500k and 5M too. The collapse to 2 trades is the 0.001 BTC lot floor at 50,000 JPY, not the mechanism: excess_return_vs_static_mix_pct went -2.98 -> +0.02, i.e. the variant essentially became its own static mix. Worth re-testing at a promotion capital where the lot floor does not bind.

name: reversal-hysteresis-multiplier
note: UNTESTABLE at the 50,000 JPY promotion capital, not disproven. The primary report is identical to the baseline in every field except orders_below_min (5960 -> 1340), so sharpe_absolute_delta is exactly 0.000 -- the same shape as the CoinGecko constant-volume VWMA, where 0.0 was arithmetic rather than evidence. At 500k it cut trades 754 -> 288 (-62%), doubled win rate 0.117 -> 0.246, and improved return -16.09% -> -11.20% and Sharpe -29.57 -> -19.36.

name: rebalance-spacing-15m
note: Rejected on Sharpe (-3.128) and drawdown (+1.57pp) at the primary capital. Effect sign flips between capitals: at 500k/5M spacing halved turnover as predicted (-36% volume, +4.11pp return at 500k), but at 50,000 JPY the lot floor was the real turnover brake and wider spacing lets the delta accumulate, so turnover ROSE 58%. Its prerequisite enabling fix is PR #21, whose merge is gated on a live-vs-backtest semantic question.

name: post-trade-cooldown-30m
note: UNTESTABLE at the 50,000 JPY promotion capital, not disproven. The primary report is identical to the baseline in every field except orders_below_min (5394 -> 5392), so sharpe_absolute_delta is exactly 0.000 -- arithmetic, not evidence. The baseline itself makes only 1 trade this window, so there was no second trade for a cooldown to suppress: of the 13 candles the gate reached, 2 cleared allocation_threshold and ZERO would have produced an order above the 0.001 BTC lot floor. At 500,000 JPY the mechanism suppressed 1,984 real orders, cut trades 765 -> 416 (-46%), and improved Sharpe -30.58 -> -22.19 (+8.386), return -16.69% -> -12.39% and max drawdown 16.91% -> 12.57%; compare-backtest returns promoted:true at BOTH diagnostic capitals. name: ewma-smoothed-composite-signal
note: UNTESTABLE at the 50,000 JPY promotion capital, not disproven -- same shape as post-trade-cooldown-30m and as the CoinGecko constant-volume VWMA. The primary report is identical to the baseline in every field except orders_below_min (5394 -> 209, -96%), which proves the filter fired; it simply had no P&L consequence where the lot floor already suppressed 100% of rebalances. The filter measurably works: realized signal range shrank 48.6% (0.3190 -> 0.1641) and stddev 50.6% (0.07323 -> 0.03617) with the mean preserved to 4dp. At 500,000 JPY it is the largest improvement this pipeline has measured: Sharpe -30.58 -> -6.17, return -16.69% -> -3.73%, max drawdown 16.91% -> 4.52%, fee drag 5.75% -> 0.60%, win rate 0.108 -> 0.417, excess_return_vs_static_mix_pct -13.56 -> -0.54 -- and unlike boundary-rebalance-no-trade-band it does NOT collapse to a static mix (48 trades, 24/24 buy/sell). CAVEAT: the half-life is expressed in BARS; the live SignalEngine re-evaluates at ~4 Hz, so live the effective half-life would be ~7.5s of market time, not 30 minutes. Non-transferable to live until that cadence is resolved. Implementation preserved on origin/experiment/ewma-smoothed-composite-signal (cargo test 236 passed); compute_btc_target untouched.

name: ta-weight-085-signal-amplitude
note: GENUINELY TESTED and decisively refuted -- the only one of today's three the primary capital could score. Amplitude rose 1.2143x (= 0.85/0.70), pushing 143 rebalances through the lot floor that the baseline could not clear: trades 1 -> 144 at 50k, 765 -> 1100 at 500k. Worse on every promotion criterion at all three capitals: Sharpe -5.367 -> -19.401 (-14.034), max drawdown 4.23% -> 12.05% (+7.82pp), return -3.28% -> -11.41%, fee_drag_pct 0.08 -> 4.62. The hypothesis's factual premise was verified TRUE in all four parts (empty news slice pins sentiment_normalized at 0.5; combined spans [0.15,0.85] at ta_weight 0.7; apply_zone's saturation arms are structurally unreachable; target confined to [0.0625,0.9375]) -- but the diagnosis it implied is WRONG. The realized composite never leaves [0.3359, 0.6548], nowhere near either bound, so the zone and the constant sentiment term were never what compressed the signal; the five-sub-signal weighted mean is. Reweighting only dilates the same curve about its centre, buying turnover and cost without buying information.

name: ewma-smoothed-signal-wallclock-30m
note: REJECTED ON THE TRADE-COUNT CRITERION ALONE, on a run where the primary capital was NOT degenerate (baseline 48 trades). Both other criteria passed decisively: Sharpe -5.849 -> -3.299 (+2.550 absolute) and max drawdown 5.67% -> 4.61% (-1.06pp). Trade count 2 vs 48 = 4%, below the 50% floor. Same shape at both diagnostic capitals: 500k Sharpe +23.572 (-29.137 -> -5.565), drawdown 16.47% -> 4.91%, trades 64 vs 771 = 8%; 5M Sharpe +17.681, drawdown 13.44% -> 4.70%, trades 8%. The wall-clock reformulation works and is cadence-invariant by construction and by test (a 0->1 step reaches 0.5 after 1800s whether delivered as 30x60s or 7200x250ms updates), so unlike the bar-indexed ewma-smoothed-composite-signal this version IS transferable to the live ~4 Hz engine. Mechanism measured: smoothed signal range -35.7% (0.318991 -> 0.205012), sd -43.7% (0.073610 -> 0.041478); bar-to-bar target moves >= allocation_threshold went 228 raw -> 0 smoothed. CAVEAT: at 50k the variant makes 2 trades, both buys, win rate 0.0, and excess_return_vs_static_mix_pct goes -1.683 -> -0.046, i.e. it again approximates its own static mix; the 500k/5M runs, with 33/31 buy/sell and ~4.6 trades/day, are the informative ones. Implementation preserved on origin/experiment/ewma-smoothed-signal-wallclock-30m (cargo test 255 passed); compute_btc_target untouched.

name: subsignal-agreement-gate
note: REJECTED ON THE TRADE-COUNT CRITERION ALONE (1 vs 48 = 2%). Sharpe -5.849 -> -3.146 (+2.703) and max drawdown 5.67% -> 4.05% (-1.62pp) both passed. At 500k: Sharpe +18.065, drawdown 16.47% -> 7.62%, trades 199 vs 771 = 26%. THE VERDICT IS NOT THE VALUABLE PART. The instrumented run answers 2026-09-13's lead #4 decisively: over 15,286 candles the gate rejected 13,117 (85.8%), and on ALL 2,998 candles where all five sub-signals expressed an opinion they NEVER ONCE reached 4-of-5 agreement, nor were the 8,230 four-vote candles ever unanimous. Every pass came from a sparse 1-3 voter candle. The composite's narrow [0.3359, 0.6548] band is therefore GENUINE CANCELLATION between a reversion family (RSI, %B) and a trend family (SMA/EMA/MACD) that are near-mechanically opposed -- price above its moving averages is usually also high in the Bollinger band -- not a small real edge being averaged down. Gating did not widen the realized band, it narrowed it ([0.2655,0.7212] -> [0.2876,0.6975] plus an 85.8% point mass at exactly 0.5), because the most extreme points were themselves the disagreeing ones. Also recorded, not retuned: AGREEMENT_MIN_FRACTION=0.8 with majority >= 0.8*n_votes demands unanimity at n=2,3,4 (3-of-4 = 75% fails), so the gate was far stricter than '4 of 5' on sparse candles. Implementation preserved on origin/experiment/subsignal-agreement-gate (cargo test 253 passed); compute_btc_target's BODY was modified (signature unchanged).

name: post-trade-cooldown-90m
note: GENUINELY TESTED AND REFUTED at the promotion capital -- the only one of today's three whose rejection was decided by the strategy metrics rather than by the trade-count floor, and the first cooldown result this pipeline has been able to score at 50,000 JPY. Sharpe -5.849 -> -11.549 (-5.701), max drawdown 5.67% -> 8.07% (+2.40pp), return -3.76% -> -6.89%; the trade-count criterion PASSED at 175%. The counter-intuitive mechanism is measured, not inferred: a suppression-only gate RAISED the trade count at 50k (48 -> 84) because the 0.001 BTC lot floor, not the signal, sets trade size there -- suppressing rebalances lets allocation drift accumulate, so the pending delta clears the floor more often (orders_below_min 6203 -> 4376, 1,827 previously-dropped rebalances became 36 extra fills, traded volume doubled, fee_drag_pct 1.70 -> 2.83). The cooldown fired hard everywhere (465 suppressions at 50k, 5,141 at 500k, 5,140 at 5M). At the diagnostic capitals it looks strongly beneficial on Sharpe (+17.456 at 500k, +13.624 at 5M) and drawdown but fails trade count at 25%. It closes no part of the static-mix gap at any capital (sharpe_minus_static_mix -8.41 at 50k vs baseline -2.72). Discarded outright: worktree and branch deleted, nothing preserved. compute_btc_target untouched.

name: classic-macd-periods
note: PROMOTED -- the first promotion since 2026-09-08 and the first three-Pro, zero-Con verdict this pipeline has produced. Sharpe -5.494 -> -5.329 (+0.166 absolute, clearing the 0.1 floor), max drawdown 5.16% -> 5.13% (-0.03pp), trade count 20 vs 24 = 83%. kind: parameter, so no source change: macd_fast 52 -> 12, macd_slow 104 -> 26, macd_signal 18 -> 9 and nothing else, isolating the one indicator horizon never re-examined since the 2026-09-09 resolution fix. PR #24 against dev; an operator must also apply the values via PUT /api/config on the running instance. THREE HONEST CAVEATS, all recorded in the PR: (1) the hypothesis's own directional prediction was WRONG at the deciding capital -- it predicted a faster MACD would raise turnover, and at 50k turnover FELL (20 vs 24 trades, 266k vs 322k JPY volume), so the trade-count floor was cleared by margin rather than by the predicted mechanism; (2) both diagnostic capitals are slightly WORSE and agree in sign (500k Sharpe -30.468 vs -30.457, return -16.67% vs -16.64%; 5M Sharpe -24.143 vs -24.123) -- unthrottled by the lot floor the faster MACD trades slightly more (792 vs 789/791) and loses slightly more; (3) it does not close the benchmark gap, sharpe_minus_static_mix -1.315 -> -1.149 but still firmly negative, and both hold (-4.97%) and the static mix (-2.75%) still beat the strategy. The improvement has the shape 'trade slightly less in a down market'. cargo test 246 passed on an unmodified tree; compute_btc_target untouched.

name: family-vote-aggregation
note: GENUINELY REFUTED, not a trade-count rejection: Sharpe -5.494 -> -22.941 (-17.447), max drawdown 5.16% -> 13.48% (+8.32pp), return -3.59% -> -12.97%; the trade-count criterion PASSED at 821% (197 vs 24). Answers 2026-09-14's lead #4 with a measurement. Collapsing the five sub-signals to two family votes (unweighted mean within each family, then the existing 1.0/0.25 family weights) makes the realised reversion:trend ratio exactly 4:1 instead of 2.67:1. Instrumented over the same 15,417 candles, emitting BOTH formulas per call: the composite band widened from [0.335850, 0.654840] to [0.334181, 0.681205] -- width +8.8%, sd +19.4% (0.0736 -> 0.0878) -- and the baseline column reproduced the 2026-09-14 figure EXACTLY, validating the harness. So the cancellation is only PARTLY a vote-counting artifact: removing the 3-vs-2 inflation does let the composite reach further, but essentially all the widening is on the bullish side (max 0.6548 -> 0.6812, min 0.3359 -> 0.3342) and a 4:1 ratio still leaves the composite inside roughly +/-0.17 of neutral. The two families really are near-mechanically opposed, as 2026-09-14 concluded. The 8.8% wider band drove 8.2x the turnover at 50k, and that extra turnover was pure damage (fee_drag_pct 0.90 -> 6.02). Both diagnostics agree (500k Sharpe -38.461, 5M -30.764). compute_btc_target's BODY was modified (signature unchanged); cargo test 250 passed, two existing tests' expected values legitimately updated, none weakened or deleted. Discarded outright: worktree and branch deleted.

name: contrarian-trend-subsignals
note: GENUINELY REFUTED and the most informative result of the run. Sharpe -5.494 -> -23.861 (-18.366), max drawdown 5.16% -> 14.81% (+9.64pp), return -3.59% -> -14.11%; trade count PASSED at 867% (208 vs 24). First test of the trend family's SIGN rather than its gain -- trend-weighted-subsignals, trend-weight-half and mean-reversion-weighted-subsignals all varied a non-negative weight and none could have detected a sign error. Literature-motivated (arXiv:2608.21888, crypto short-horizon dynamics measured as reversal-dominant, 'the signal lives in signs, not magnitudes'). The predicted mechanism was CONFIRMED and the outcome still refuted the idea: inverting the trend family makes all five sub-signals agree instead of oppose, and the composite band widened 1.66x ([0.3359,0.6548] -> [0.2410,0.7712], sd 0.0736 -> 0.1201), with turnover rising 24 -> 208 at 50k and 789 -> 1439 at 500k. THE STANDING CONCLUSION THIS SUPPORTS: taken with ta-weight-085-signal-amplitude (2026-09-13, amplified the composite, Sharpe -14.034), the composite now has negative edge in BOTH signs, so band width itself is the damage mechanism -- whichever way it points, a wider band means more exposure swing, more turnover and more fee drag against a series the signal cannot time. Both the gain and the sign of the trend family have now been tested; what has never been tested is whether the composite should drive exposure AT ALL versus a damped or static allocation. compute_btc_target's BODY was modified (signature unchanged); cargo test 251 passed. One fixture outside engine.rs was adapted and is flagged rather than buried: simulator.rs::run_with_drawdown_limit used a RISING price series to build a BTC position before its crash, which reads bearish under the inversion, so it was flipped to a falling series -- all three assertions (circuit_breaker_trips >= 1, orders_rejected >= 1, the 0.99-limit inert case) unchanged. Discarded outright: worktree and branch deleted.
